synopsis: Bell Harrow, RR 203. Ysoly Tamm assembles her last crossing on the stepped quays: water weighed at the weighbridge against the Compact's ten-pound cylinder, a licence tile fired and hung at her neck, two hundred and twelve blocks of Assembly ballast stacked low between the axles, nine wagons, forty-one hask, eleven hands. Sabra Onn argues four days' grace out of her; Oreth Vask prices the crossing without finishing a sentence; Pell Corrow pays down his debt to Thecla Bram in news, because news is cheaper than salt. On the last morning a Warden-surveyor named Denet Rasca comes aboard with a College-sealed glass and a hide packet stitched shut under two seals that can only be struck once. Nobody will open it. Ysoly enters it on the way-bill as passenger's goods, gives Hanei charge of it, and the bell rings the Tamm Line out nine times.
title: The Last Loading
